subtopics.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia: Biology, Treatment, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on AML pathogenesis, molecular subtypes, epigenetic drivers, and clinical management including induction chemotherapy, targeted agents (IDH inhibitors, FLT3 inhibitors, venetoclax, azacitidine), and outcomes in newly diagnosed and relapsed/refractory disease.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular subtypes, epigenetic drivers, and targeted therapies in newly diagnosed and relapsed AML.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma Biology, Molecular Pathogenesis, and Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and epigenetic mechanisms driving B-cell and T-cell lymphomas (DLBCL, follicular lymphoma, mantle cell lymphoma, PTCL, ALCL, CLL), including novel therapeutic strategies such as BTK inhibitors, EZH2 inhibitors, CAR T-cell therapy, and immunochemotherapy regimens.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic and molecular mechanisms driving B- and T-cell lymphomas, with novel targeted and cellular therapies.

subtopics.label: Myeloproliferative Neoplasms and Myelodysplastic Syndromes
subtopics.description: Research on the biology, diagnosis, and management of MPNs (polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia, myelofibrosis) and MDS, including JAK2 mutations, epigenetic alterations, interferon therapy, and disease progression to blast phase.
subtopics.short_description: Biology, diagnosis, and management of MPNs and myelodysplastic syndromes, including JAK2 mutations and disease progression.

subtopics.label: Multiple Myeloma: Genomics, Smoldering Disease, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on multiple myeloma biology including genomic profiling of smoldering myeloma, genetic subtypes, treatment with CAR T-cell therapy, proteasome inhibitors, and novel agents, as well as allogeneic transplantation outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Genomic profiling of smoldering and active myeloma, with CAR T-cell therapy, proteasome inhibitors, and transplant outcomes.

subtopics.label: Hematopoiesis, Stem Cell Biology, and Bone Marrow Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research on normal and malignant hematopoiesis including hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal, epigenetic regulation, bone marrow niche signaling, clonal hematopoiesis, and aging-associated remodeling of hematopoietic topography.
subtopics.display_name: Hematopoietic Stem Cells & Bone Marrow Niche
subtopics.short_description: Stem cell self-renewal, epigenetic regulation, clonal hematopoiesis, and bone marrow microenvironment signaling.

subtopics.label: CAR T-Cell and Cellular Immunotherapy for Hematologic Malignancies
subtopics.description: Research on CAR T-cell therapy design, clinical outcomes, resistance mechanisms, and combination strategies for hematologic malignancies including B-cell lymphoma, AML, ALL, and multiple myeloma.
subtopics.display_name: CAR T-Cell Therapy for Blood Cancers
subtopics.short_description: Design, clinical outcomes, resistance mechanisms, and combination strategies for CAR T-cell therapy in hematologic malignancies.

subtopics.label: Venous Thromboembolism: Risk, Prevention, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology, risk factors, prophylaxis, and management of venous thromboembolism (DVT and PE) across diverse patient populations including cancer patients, surgical patients, pediatric IBD, and pregnancy, including anticoagulation strategies and hereditary thrombophilia.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, prophylaxis, and anticoagulation strategies for DVT and PE across diverse patient populations.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Embolism: Catheter-Based Therapies and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the management of acute pulmonary embolism with catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, and anticoagulation, including comparative effectiveness, risk stratification, and outcomes in diverse patient populations.
subtopics.short_description: Catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, and risk stratification for acute pulmonary embolism.

subtopics.label: Transfusion Medicine: Pediatric and Critical Care Practices
subtopics.description: Research on blood component transfusion practices, thresholds, and outcomes in critically ill children, neonates, and patients undergoing cardiac surgery or ECMO, including red blood cell, platelet, and plasma transfusion guidelines.
subtopics.short_description: Blood component transfusion practices, thresholds, and outcomes in critically ill children, neonates, and cardiac surgery patients.

subtopics.label: Red Blood Cell Disorders, Anemia, and Transfusion Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on anemia management, red blood cell transfusion outcomes in surgical and hospitalized patients, sickle cell disease, thalassemia, and erythropoiesis including iron deficiency and hemoglobin disorders.
subtopics.display_name: Red Blood Cell Disorders & Anemia Management
subtopics.short_description: Anemia treatment, sickle cell disease, thalassemia, and transfusion outcomes in surgical and hospitalized patients.

subtopics.label: Iron Metabolism, Iron Deficiency, and Iron Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on iron deficiency anemia treatment with intravenous iron formulations, iron metabolism in chronic kidney disease, FGF23-related mineral homeostasis, hepcidin biology, and adverse effects of iron therapy including hypophosphatemia.
subtopics.short_description: Intravenous iron treatment, hepcidin biology, FGF23-related mineral homeostasis, and adverse effects of iron therapy.

subtopics.label: Coagulation Disorders, Anticoagulation, and Hemostasis Management
subtopics.description: Research on anticoagulation therapy management including warfarin, direct oral anticoagulants, antiplatelet agents, fibrinogen replacement, and hemostasis in clinical settings such as cardiac surgery, trauma, and procedural interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Anticoagulation management with DOACs, warfarin, and antiplatelet agents across cardiac, trauma, and procedural settings.

subtopics.label: COVID-19-Associated Coagulopathy, Thrombosis, and Vascular Injury
subtopics.description: Research on the thrombotic and coagulopathic complications of COVID-19 including complement-mediated microvascular injury, pulmonary embolism incidence, hypercoagulable states, and the vascular pathology of severe SARS-CoV-2 infection.
subtopics.short_description: Thrombotic and coagulopathic complications of COVID-19, including complement-mediated microvascular injury and hypercoagulable states.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation: Outcomes, Complications, and Access
subtopics.description: Research on allogeneic and autologous hematopoietic cell transplantation including cord blood transplantation, donor selection, GVHD, infectious complications, engraftment, and disparities in transplant access across racial and ethnic groups.
subtopics.short_description: Allogeneic and autologous HCT outcomes, GVHD, cord blood transplantation, and racial disparities in transplant access.

subtopics.label: Platelet Biology, Platelet Disorders, and Thrombocytopenia Management
subtopics.description: Research on platelet function, platelet transfusion thresholds and outcomes, immune thrombocytopenia diagnosis and treatment, thrombotic microangiopathies, and platelet-related hemostatic disorders including lusutrombopag use and antiphospholipid syndrome.
subtopics.short_description: Platelet function, immune thrombocytopenia, thrombotic microangiopathies, and platelet transfusion thresholds and outcomes.

subtopics.label: Stroke, Cerebrovascular Events, and Antithrombotic Management
subtopics.description: Research on ischemic stroke mechanisms, cerebral venous thrombosis, intracerebral hemorrhage, and anticoagulation/antiplatelet strategies for stroke prevention and treatment, including cancer-associated stroke and atrial fibrillation-related stroke.
subtopics.short_description: Ischemic stroke, cerebral venous thrombosis, and anticoagulation strategies for stroke prevention in cancer and atrial fibrillation.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma Diagnosis, Staging, and Bone Marrow Assessment
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating diagnostic tools and staging procedures for lymphoma, including the role of bone marrow biopsy versus PET/CT imaging, CSF analysis, and pathologic assessment in B-cell and T-cell lymphomas.
subtopics.short_description: Bone marrow biopsy, PET/CT imaging, CSF analysis, and pathologic staging tools for B- and T-cell lymphomas.

subtopics.label: Targeted Therapy and Novel Agents in Lymphoma and CLL
subtopics.description: Clinical and preclinical studies of targeted agents including BTK inhibitors (acalabrutinib, ibrutinib), CDK4/6 inhibitors, venetoclax, and BET inhibitors in B-cell malignancies, CLL, and mantle cell lymphoma.
subtopics.short_description: BTK inhibitors, venetoclax, CDK4/6 inhibitors, and BET inhibitors in B-cell malignancies, CLL, and mantle cell lymphoma.

subtopics.label: AML and MDS: Novel Therapeutics, Molecular Biology, and Maintenance Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on novel therapeutic strategies in AML and MDS including oral azacitidine maintenance, BET and ENL YEATS inhibitors, BCL6 targeting, and molecular/cytogenomic characterization of disease subtypes.
subtopics.display_name: AML & MDS Novel Therapeutics & Molecular Biology
subtopics.short_description: Oral azacitidine maintenance, BET and ENL YEATS inhibitors, BCL6 targeting, and cytogenomic characterization of AML and MDS.

subtopics.label: Lung Lymphatic Dysfunction, Vascular Biology, and Pulmonary Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on lymphatic endothelial cell biology in the lung, including cigarette smoke-induced lymphatic thrombosis and dysfunction, PAR1-mediated lymphatic drainage, and the role of lymphatic dysfunction in COPD and emphysema.
subtopics.short_description: Lymphatic endothelial dysfunction in the lung, PAR1-mediated drainage, and lymphatic contributions to COPD and emphysema.

subtopics.label: Spaceflight Biology: Multi-Omics, Immune Responses, and Cardiovascular Effects
subtopics.description: Multi-omic and single-cell studies characterizing physiological, immunological, and coagulation changes in astronauts during and after spaceflight, including secretome profiling and cardiovascular risk assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Multi-omic profiling of immune, coagulation, and cardiovascular changes in astronauts during and after spaceflight.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Complications, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Clinical studies examining COVID-19 outcomes in hospitalized patients including cancer history, viral load, inflammatory markers, organ dysfunction subphenotypes, pregnancy complications, post-acute sequelae, and treatment strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Hospitalized COVID-19 outcomes including inflammatory markers, organ dysfunction, post-acute sequelae, and treatment strategies.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Biology, Vascular Development, and Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Research on endothelial cell specification, transcription factor regulation (ETS factors, c-Maf), endothelial colony-forming cells, and endothelial-leukemia cell interactions relevant to vascular homeostasis and hematologic malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Endothelial specification, transcription factor regulation, and endothelial-leukemia cell interactions in vascular homeostasis.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence, NLP, and Machine Learning in Hematology Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Studies applying machine learning, natural language processing, and AI-driven image analysis to hematopathology diagnosis, flow cytometry classification, report extraction, and clinical decision support in hematologic diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, NLP, and AI-driven image analysis for hematopathology diagnosis, flow cytometry, and clinical decision support.

subtopics.label: Cancer-Associated Arterial Thromboembolism and Vascular Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on arterial thromboembolism risk in solid cancer patients, including tumor genomic predictors of thrombosis, ischemic stroke mechanisms in cancer, and management of vascular complications in oncology.
subtopics.short_description: Arterial thromboembolism risk in solid cancer patients, including genomic predictors of thrombosis and vascular complication management.

subtopics.label: Sickle Cell Disease: Clinical Management, Pain, and Global Health
subtopics.description: Research on sickle cell disease management including opioid prescribing patterns, linkage-to-care interventions in low-resource settings, and clinical outcomes in pediatric and adult populations.
subtopics.display_name: Sickle Cell Disease Management & Global Health
subtopics.short_description: Pain management, opioid prescribing, linkage-to-care interventions, and clinical outcomes in pediatric and adult sickle cell disease.

subtopics.label: Eosinophil Biology and Gene Therapy for Eosinophilic Disorders
subtopics.description: Preclinical and translational studies on eosinophil-targeting strategies including AAV-mediated gene therapy for hypereosinophilia and chronic eosinophilic leukemia, and neutrophil/eosinophil regulatory mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated gene therapy for hypereosinophilia and chronic eosinophilic leukemia, and eosinophil regulatory mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Clonal Hematopoiesis, Somatic Mutations, and Cancer Risk
subtopics.description: Studies examining clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP), mosaic chromosomal alterations, and somatic mutations as risk factors for hematologic and solid malignancies, including lineage tracing approaches.
subtopics.short_description: CHIP, mosaic chromosomal alterations, and somatic mutations as risk factors for hematologic and solid malignancies.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation: Perioperative Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on perioperative outcomes, transfusion practices, and intraoperative management in lung transplantation, including cystic fibrosis retransplantation and disease-specific considerations.
subtopics.short_description: Perioperative management, transfusion practices, and intraoperative outcomes in lung transplantation including cystic fibrosis cases.

subtopics.label: B Cell Differentiation, Humoral Immunity, and Lymphoma Models
subtopics.description: Research on B cell biology including OCT2-mediated chromatin remodeling in humoral immunity, ROCK1-mediated proteostasis, CRISPR-based B cell models, EZH2-driven lymphoma niche formation, and dendritic cell cross-presentation.
subtopics.short_description: OCT2-mediated chromatin remodeling, ROCK1 proteostasis, CRISPR lymphoma models, and EZH2-driven lymphoma niche formation.
